newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangdong Inv to offer 350 mln brewery shares.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv to offer 350 mln brewery shares.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd said on Monday it would float its Guangdong Brewery Holdings Ltd unit by offering 350 million new shares in the wholly-owned subsidiary.
The new shares would represent 28 percent of the enlarged share capital of Guangdong Brewery and Guangdong Investment would own about 72 percent after the listing, it said in a statement.
About 216.62 million shares would be reserved for Guangdong Investment shareholders who would be able to apply for one share for every eight Guangdong Investment shares held on July 28.
Trading in the Guangdong Brewery shares is due to begin on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong on August 8.
The issue will be principally underwritten by Jardine Fleming Securities Ltd.

Guangdong Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd, which holds about 38.8 percent of Guangdong Investment, has agreed to limit its participation in the new share issue by subscribing for a maximum 37.5 million preferential shares, or about 10.71 percent of the new issue.
The application period for the new share issue will close at noon on August 1.

Guangdong Investment said since Guangdong Brewery was not classified as a major subsidiary and the dilution of its interest would not be considered material, the spinoff was not subject to the approval of Guangdong Investment shareholders.
Guangdong Brewery and its units are principally involved in the production, distribution, and sale of "Kingway" beer.

Its main assets are stakes in Sino-foreign joint venture companies Shenzhen Kingway Brewery Co Ltd, Shenzhen Kingway Brewing Co Ltd, Shenzhen Kingway Packaging Co Ltd and Shenzhen Kingway Utility Co Ltd.
Shenzhen Brewery posted net profit after tax of about 89.1 million yuan in 1996 compared with 83.6 million in 1995. Its net asset value at the end of 1996 was about 328.3 million yuan.
Shenzhen Brewery operates a production plant in Shenzhen, which has annual production capacity of 200,000 tonnes.

It also has a 60 percent stake in each of the joint venture companies which will together operate a second beer production plant. The second plant is currently under construction and is designed to have initial annual production of 200,000 tonnes.
It is scheduled to begin operations in early 1998.

Guangdong Investment said its Guangdong Brewery unit was of sufficient size and strength to compete independently and enlarging its capital base would provide it with additional financial resources to expand.

Guangdong Investment said its future direction would not be limited to that of an investment holding. "It will continue to principally participate in the management of both its existing businesses and new opportunities," it said.
